reviews.text: Selecting Pool Xperts to take our vision and transform our backyard into an oasis was an incredible experience. We set very high expectations, and they didn't disappoint, going above and beyond every step of the way. Their beautiful showroom provided a place to see full size samples of materials and products. Our salesperson Tim's expertise provided valuable feedback in helping us with our selections to ensure everything turned out perfect. Once the project started, Alain the owner, was onsite everyday overseeing every step of the build. We asked for several changes in the middle of the project and he handled them effortlessly. After only 8 weeks we now have a stunning backyard that we are proud to share with family and friends and create the special memories. If you're looking for a pool builder, you must give Pool Xperts a call. Alain and his team treated us like family and not just another customer.
reviews.author: Jeff Carroll

reviews.text:
**Outstanding Pool Builder Experience**

I recently had the pleasure of working with Pool Xperts for the construction of my new pool, and I couldn't be more thrilled with the result. From start to finish, the entire process was seamless and professional.

The initial consultation with Tim was thorough and informative. He took the time to understand my vision and provided valuable insights that enhanced my ideas. Their expertise was evident as they walked me through every detail, from design options to material choices and at no point did we feel pressured or get any kind of “sales pitch.”

Throughout the construction phase, Alain and his team displayed exceptional craftsmanship and dedication. They adhered to the timeline and budget, and their attention to detail was remarkable. The communication was top-notch, with regular updates and prompt responses to any questions I had.

The finished pool exceeded my expectations. It’s not just a beautiful addition to my property, but also a testament to Pool Xperts skill and commitment to quality. The project was completed ahead of schedule with minimal disruption, and the site was left clean and organized.

I highly recommend Pool Xperts to anyone considering a pool project. Their professionalism, expertise, and dedication to customer satisfaction set them apart from the competition. Thank you, Pool Xperts, for making our dream pool a reality!
reviews.author: Nicolai Soler

reviews.text: Lupe came out to talk to us about a potential grout project in our pool. He was prompt, very knowledgeable and explained every detail of what would needed to be done. I felt very confident in the advice he gave us and would be confident in hiring thru them for pool til and grout repairs

reviews.text: Lupe and team did a great job installing our new spa and pool lights today!  Answered all of our questions, drained minimal amount of water from the pool, and installed new lights from the deck.  Great work!  We will use them again for any future repairs.  Thank you Pool Xperts!
reviews.author: Carol Cocke

reviews.text: PoolXperts are truly the EXPERTS! They were on it, the entire pool build, every inch of the way, attentive and informative. Every step was defined and explained in detail. Any time we called or asked a question, we got an immediate response. I will be a lifetime customer of PoolXperts!!!
reviews.author: Lance Harper

reviews.text: Pool Xperts did a fantastic job on our pool! We could not be happier! Our yard is small and they made the best of the space by designing a pool that not only met our needs, but exceeded our expectations. Tim, Sandra, and Alain were a pleasure to work with - always friendly, helpful and professional. Alain was onsite everyday. He kept us informed of the progress and next steps throughout construction. He was always available to answer our questions or address any concerns. We highly recommend Pool Xperts!!!
reviews.author: Toni Hoch

reviews.text: Pool XPerts did an outstanding job giving us the pool of our dreams. The outcome exceeded our expectations and the entire process was seamless. Alan was hands-on and present during the entire build and kept us updated throughout the process. Thank you, Alan, Tim, Lupe and Sandra for your professionalism and excellent customer service!
reviews.author: Janet Duffin

reviews.text: Fantastic experience. The entire team at Pool Xperts made building our pool a breeze. We are absolutely in love with it. They have also made sure to address any concerns we have had extremely quickly, with care and a willingness to help. I definitely reccomend Pool Xperts to build your dream pool!
